scope: Coherent six-file e41f8755 default accounting v2, no runtime/output approval
accepted_boundaries: ClassDefaultPremise validates exact current PreparedDocument identity, document path, live checkpoint seal, successful preparation, supplying-channel hash, exact source-container identity and absence of every declared spelling in both document and checkpoint. Its value comes only from matching prepared overlay; it is channel accounting, not a source mechanism/default-survival proof.

RegisteredConstructorDefaultPremise is an exact closed provider, not an arbitrary callback/subclass. It adds re-derived current index/root constructor/default evidence to the same address guard and compares the full registration, exact parameter/path and type-sensitive value hash.

The registered-constructor helper relocation is AST-identical to independently accepted DD1 v2 after renaming and removal of the now-local self import. Exact-one-registration-decorator guard and explicit formal rewrite refusal are retained.

Explicit provider admission and value/address checks precede initial resolve record even with _record_events=False. ConfigResolution.consume and bind validate exact provider type, state/source_kind/provenance/selection metadata/source container/component/canonical and value before emission, including without capture.

Default events retain absent_default, present=False, alias=None and missing value-state. path_exact and class_default provenance describe the validated default address only. selected_path remains None and ConsumedConfigDecision.occurrence remains None; default_path carries the separate address. Existing present-only occurrence census is unchanged.
Diffusion selector now constructs the source provider before the first resolve event, rather than first emitting an unqualified absence. Compound expectation/receipt proof logic remains separate.

Bare/foreign/failed/overlay-mismatched default dictionaries may retain legacy value behavior but receive no exact premise; this does not authorize a stronger proof. Mutation/null-alias/invalid-parent/foreign-container/foreign-document and no-capture poisoned-provider controls inspected.
